magneto.modal.update.screen3.text: Magneto boards can now be exported in PowerPoint format! Click the "Export" button then "Download". The content of all your cards will be inserted into a slideshow, and all you'll have to do is apply the layout you want!
magneto.modal.update.screen3.title: Export the board as a slideshow
magneto.modal.update.screen4.text: From the sharing window, select the option to make your board public. A link will be created making it accessible to any user, even without logging in to the ENT!
